records.description: CZ Solar Warren, LLC is the project company for Cincinnati Zoo Solar, a 28 MW utility-scale solar array on leased Cincinnati Zoo land at Bowyer Farm in Warren County, Ohio. Melink Solar Development originated the project, Soltage acquired the development interest in 2022, and Harrison Street acquired the project from Soltage in September 2022 through its Social Infrastructure Strategy. Public sources do not disclose Harrison Street's specific fund, managed account, upstream holding vehicle, or ownership percentage. The project sells output under two ten-year Calpine Energy Solutions power-purchase agreements, uses Inovateus Solar as EPC, and received tax-equity financing from Nelnet through separate tenant and landlord vehicles; those tax-equity percentages are not treated as direct PortCo ownership stakes. Cincinnati Zoo reported the array operating in 2026, and no subsequent sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.

records.description: Bear River Midstream is a U.S. natural-gas-storage platform operating Stallion Gas Storage in Wyoming and Salt Plains Gas Storage in Oklahoma. Together the facilities comprise three storage fields with 72 Bcf of certificated working-gas capacity and interconnections serving utilities, pipelines, power generators, industrial users, marketers and producers. records.description: Zenith Energy Portland Terminal is a standalone liquid-bulk storage and multimodal fuels terminal at 5501 NW Front Avenue on Portland's Willamette River. The facility connects marine, rail, truck and pipeline logistics and has 1,518,200 barrels of operator-listed storage capacity. It handles renewable fuels, sustainable-aviation-fuel components and blends, biodiesel, aviation gasoline, distillates and crude oil during a permitted transition that requires crude handling and storage to end by October 2027. Warburg Pincus and Kelso & Company acquired the broader Zenith Energy U.S. platform in 2017 and remain the current sponsors while their signed sale of the Portland terminal is pending. I Squared Capital's Energy Transition Fund, through ISQ Springer Aggregator and ISQ Springer Holdings, signed to acquire 100% on December 16, 2025. The required Portland franchise-transfer ordinance remained pending and no legal closing evidence was found through August 19, 2026, so I Squared is not represented as an active owner or assigned an investment year. The Portland terminal is counted as a standalone PortCo; its tanks, docks, pipeline, racks and conversion projects remain subordinate assets.
